items.originalTitle: Introducing our 2027 Atlassian Williams F1 Team challenger name - the FW50. The designation skips straight from this year’s FW48, just as the team sk...
items.summaryEn:
Introducing our 2027 Atlassian Williams F1 Team challenger name - the FW50.
The designation skips straight from this year’s FW48, just as the team skipped from FW38 to FW40 on its 40th anniversary.
detailZh:
阿斯顿·马丁威廉姆斯F1车队公布了2027年的赛车名称为FW50。
这一命名直接跳过了今年的FW48，正如车队在其40周年时从FW38跳到FW40一样。
detailEn:
Introducing our 2027 Atlassian Williams F1 Team challenger name - the FW50.
The designation skips straight from this year’s FW48, just as the team skipped from FW38 to FW40 on its 40th anniversary.

items.titleZh: 威廉姆斯车队庆祝F1 50周年纪念
items.summaryZh: 威廉姆斯车队宣布2027年将庆祝其在F1的50周年，并推出纪念W50标志。

media.altZh: 威廉姆斯车队庆祝F1 50周年纪念 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: 2027 will be the 50th anniversary that Atlassian Williams F1 Team has raced in Formula 1 and will be marked with this commemorative W50 logo. Today’s...
items.summaryEn:
2027 will be the 50th anniversary that Atlassian Williams F1 Team has raced in Formula 1 and will be marked with this commemorative W50 logo. 
Today’s announcement is just the start, with many more 50th anniversary moments to be revealed over the coming months. 
Learn more about how we are celebrating our 50 year anniversary in Formula 1 by clicking the link here: https://bit.ly/47qQUEH
detailZh:
2027年将是阿斯顿·马丁威廉姆斯一级方程式车队参加一级方程式赛事的第50个周年，并将以这款纪念性的W50标志为标志。
今天的宣布只是开始，未来几个月还将有更多50周年纪念时刻揭晓。
点击此处了解更多我们如何庆祝一级方程式50周年：https://bit.ly/47qQUEH
detailEn:
2027 will be the 50th anniversary that Atlassian Williams F1 Team has raced in Formula 1 and will be marked with this commemorative W50 logo. 
Today’s announcement is just the start, with many more 50th anniversary moments to be revealed over the coming months. 
Learn more about how we are celebrating our 50 year anniversary in Formula 1 by clicking the link here: https://bit.ly/47qQUEH
